facts.fact: 车内 Finn 逼问「nibble」详情，Sarah 羞愤招供：她把 Ethan 掀翻在地、像野兽一样骑上去亲了他。
facts.anchor: I even threw Ethan to his back and crawled on top of him like an animal!

facts.fact: Finn 自曝旧情：他曾以为爱上了前室友（Johnny），如今承认对方比他还 fucked up。
facts.anchor: I thought I loved him… Now, I realize he was even more fucked up than me.

facts.fact: Finn 一连串点醒：Sarah 不当普通少女，去养育 Blue、照料被过去碾碎的男孩——她「付出超出负荷」。
facts.anchor: Instead of being a normal teenager, you helped raise Blue.

facts.fact: 书名二现：Finn 对痛哭的 Sarah 说——你和我，都无可救药地拴在自己的风暴上；Sarah 认他做新闺蜜。
facts.anchor: Girl, you and I are, indefinitely, anchored to our storms.

facts.fact: Finn 为多年嫉妒道歉：Ethan 多年来注视 Sarah 的一举一动——「你是他水中的星」，与 Johnny 对美人鱼的凝视同构。
facts.anchor: Like you are the star of his water.

facts.fact: 公园摊牌：Kristen 拒绝透露 Johnny 下落、亮出 JOHNNY WATTS 假名档案；Sarah 失口说出「Styx」，Kristen 称从未听过此名——危险将跟随他。
facts.anchor: I was told all danger would follow him.

facts.fact: Finn 突然发问「所以 Johnny 才杀了那个酒驾者？」——Sarah 意识到 Caleb 的凶手已死，当场晕厥。
facts.anchor: Is that why Johnny killed the drunk driver?

facts.fact: Kristen 屈服后拨出求助电话，Sarah 只看清来电人名字：River——她回来谎称「打错了」。
facts.anchor: The name River was all I could see.

facts.fact: 归途 Finn 违法发短信被 Sarah 吐槽；到家 Ethan 把她抱下车：「是记忆在纠缠你，宝贝」——有人低声说「周年」，她想起自己忘了今天是什么日子。
